description: This Java source file defines the RmiServiceEngine class, which extends GenericAsyncEngine and handles remote method invocation via RMI for Apache OFBiz services.

classes.name: RmiServiceEngine
classes.description: A class that extends GenericAsyncEngine to implement RMI-based service invocation in OFBiz.

methods.name: RmiServiceEngine
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the engine with a ServiceDispatcher.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a synchronous service call, returning the result map.

methods.description: Executes a service call without returning a result, ignoring the output.

methods.name: run
